newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Georgia's Shevardnadze to visit United States.
newsitem.headline: Georgia's Shevardnadze to visit United States.

text.p: Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze will make a state visit to the United States starting on July 17, his press service said on Thursday.
A spokesman said Shevardnadze, known best in the West as former Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev's reform-era foreign minister, would meet President Bill Clinton during the four-day trip.

He said political and economic issues would be discussed. Shevardnadze has increasingly sought western support and diplomatic involvement to try to solve his former Soviet republic's separatist conflicts.
